title: Mandatory Social Insurance Enrollment and Pension Combination Rules
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Mandatory Social Insurance Enrollment
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that enrollment in the social insurance system is mandatory and requires the existence of a regular employment relationship (علاقة عمل منتظمة) between the insured and the employer. FAIL if the note does not state that enrollment is mandatory or does not mention the requirement of a regular employment relationship between the insured and the employer.

criteria.title: Deduction at Source
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that social insurance contributions are deducted at source and remitted by the employer. FAIL if the note does not indicate that contributions are deducted at source and remitted by the employer.

criteria.title: Reinstatement Before Age 60 Triggers Pension Suspension
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that reinstatement that suspends the pension is reinstatement that occurs before reaching the age of 60 and results in the deduction of insurance premiums and the counting of the new period of service. FAIL if the note does not clarify that the suspension of the pension applies to reinstatement before the age of 60 or does not mention that such reinstatement results in the deduction of insurance premiums and the counting of the new period of service.

criteria.title: Combining Salary and Pension After Age 60
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a person reinstated after reaching the age of 60 is entitled to combine the salary and the pension, unlike the case of Ahmed. FAIL if the note does not state that reinstatement after the age of 60 entitles the person to combine the salary and the pension, or does not distinguish this from Ahmed's case.

criteria.title: Applicability to Civil Servants in Public Bodies
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the provisions of the social insurance law apply to civil servants in public bodies (الهيئات العامة). FAIL if the note does not indicate that the provisions of the social insurance law apply to civil servants in public bodies.

criteria.title: Work Injury Insurance Funded by Employer
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the resources funding work injury insurance (تأمين إصابات العمل) consist of the monthly contributions that the employer is obligated to pay. FAIL if the note does not indicate that work injury insurance is funded by monthly contributions paid by the employer.
